QUOTE: If you define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` yourself without a replacement, the library substitutes `platform_calloc_uninit`, which always returns NULL (`platform.c:24-30`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the uninit calloc returns NULL but never says the uninit free does nothing, and it frames this as a substitution rather than a default that fails instead of falling back. Half the item is stated, so it resolves to MISS.
